shared_elements: row of repeated small motifs (glyph blocks / repeated animal figures)
justification: Both are tall carved fields organised into registers, with profile creatures and a row of repeated small units, which is about as generic a correspondence as two unrelated relief traditions could produce. The content differs fundamentally: A centres on a single elaborately costumed standing human in profile holding a staff, framed by columns of script-like blocks, while B shows only stacked animals \u2014 quadrupeds, birds and a beaked creature \u2014 with no human figure, no costume detail and no writing, and the rendering conventions (fine dense linear detail vs. bold plain low relief) share nothing specific.
